paragraphs.text: The museum collects objects that people throw away: tickets, packaging, shopping lists. Nothing in it is older than fifty years, and almost every item was given by a visitor rather than bought.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Visitors may add an object if they write a sentence about it. About a third of the collection is on display at any time; the rest is stored in boxes that researchers may open by appointment.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: almost every item was given by a visitor rather than bought
items.prompt: The museum buys most of its objects.

explanation.en: Almost everything was given, not bought → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Барлығы дерлік сатып алынбай, келушілерден сыйға берілген → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Почти всё подарено посетителями, а не куплено → FALSE.

items.quote: Nothing in it is older than fifty years
items.prompt: Objects in the collection may be a hundred years old.

explanation.en: Nothing is older than fifty years → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Ничему нет больше пятидесяти лет → FALSE.

items.quote: Visitors may add an object if they write a sentence about it
items.prompt: A visitor who brings an object must write about it.

explanation.en: “if they write a sentence about it” — writing is required → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «if they write a sentence about it» — жазу керек → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.
explanation.ru: «if they write a sentence about it» — написать нужно → TRUE.

items.quote: the rest is stored in boxes that researchers may open by appointment
items.prompt: The museum plans to build a larger store.

explanation.en: No plan for a larger store is mentioned → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Қойманы кеңейту жоспары туралы ештеңе айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: О планах расширить хранилище ничего не сказано → NOT GIVEN.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
